title: Sayi, saita da ƙira kamar ƙwararrun ƙera

say: Sayi, saita da ƙira kamar ƙwararrun ƙera.
This is the video for Module 1 of Advanced Beadwork and Jewellery Making: professional materials, tools and design.
A cikin darasi na farko kun sanya beads akan igiya da waya. Babban aikin ya bambanta.
A cikin saƙar ƙwanƙwasa, kowane ƙwanƙwasa yana taɓa maƙwabtansa, don haka ƙullun da ba su dace ba suna nunawa nan da nan.

say: A cikin aikin waya, karfe yana taɓa fata duk rana. Karfe da ba daidai ba yana haifar da alamun koraye, kunnuwa ko ƙaiƙayi. Don haka siyan da kyau shine ƙwarewar ƙwararru ta farko.

say: Sanya gefen lebur na masu yankan ruwa zuwa wayar da kake ajiyewa, sannan ka ji karshen sannan ka rubuta shi idan ta kama.
Yanke ƙarshen zai iya tashi, don haka sa gilashin aminci, nuna mai yanke ƙasa kuma rufe ɗan gajeren ƙarshen.

panel.heading: Yanke waya lafiya
left: Yi fayil ɗin kowane ƙarshen da ya kama
Nuna mai yankan ƙasa, rufe ƙarshen
right: Yanke wayar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya tare da masu yankan kayan ado
Yi amfani da manne da hakora akan waya

say: Kada a taɓa yanke waya ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar ƙarfe tare da masu yankan kayan ado; yana toshe ruwan wukake. Ajiye ɓangarorin a cikin tulu, nesa da yara da ƙafar ƙafa. Kuma a yi amfani da filaye masu santsi-jawed, saboda hakora suna alamar waya.

say: Don tunawa. Girman bead suna gudu da baya, don haka 15/0 yana da kankanin. Karanta tambarin karfe kuma siffanta farantin da gaskiya. Yi amfani da wayoyin kunne marasa nickel. Ƙirƙiri samfurin 1 g, ƙara 10% kuma saya daga tsari ɗaya. Kuma kare idanunku lokacin da kuka yanke waya.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: 15/0 ya yi ƙasa da 11/0, wanda ya fi ƙasa da 8/0
Karanta tambarin: Sterling, 14/20 GF ko plated
Wayoyin kunne marasa nickel; gaya wa abokan ciniki karfe
Ƙidaya 1 g, ƙara 10%, saya daga kashi ɗaya
Gilashin a gefe da gefen ciki lokacin yankan waya

say: Yanzu lokacin ku ne. Gina katin tunasarwa da kayan aiki tare da ƙidaya g 1 na ku, saita kuma ɗaukar hoton benci, da ƙira da girman abin wuya ɗaya akan takarda.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan ku don wannan tsarin
items: Gina katin tunani
